title: bbox_blame anchor-metadata file_path mismatch
wanted_capability: Filter anchors by file_path match too, not just commit_sha, so `bbox_blame` returns the file actually being blamed.
notes: When multiple Edit tool calls share a commit_sha, the matched anchor returns the FIRST anchor's metadata.file_path, not the file actually being blamed. Causes confusing surprise notes from agents (codex caught this on Q1 of probe-team validation).
